verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26192351 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318625 (dated 2026-02-16). It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 at 6.11 USD each: item 00020 for 9,000 pcs confirmed for 2026-03-24, and item 00010 for 8,000 pcs confirmed for 2026-03-20. Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. The document has no document date, no handwritten changes and no stamps.
red_flags: The delivery terms contradict each other: EXW Boise per Sales Agreement PC-0011-2023 s.4.1, and DDP is stated as not agreed, yet the document says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer would normally arrange and pay freight, so the added charges need clarifying.
The two lines have the same material and price but different confirmed dates (2026-03-24 and 2026-03-20), and item 00020 is listed before item 00010.
The document has no issue date and no unit of measure for quantities (pieces assumed but not stated).
observations: Clean printed single-page PDF; all text is legible.
No handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs are visible.
The quantity unit is not stated; the unit price currency is USD.
The line items appear in descending order (00020 before 00010).
